about.text: I'm a full-stack developer specializing in React, Next.js, and modern web tooling. Since 2023 I've independently designed, built, and deployed six production applications — from AI-powered tools to real-time chat systems — and I'm now taking on freelance projects and full-time roles where I can bring that same focus to your product.

whyMe.title: What I Bring to
whyMe.card1Desc: I build modular, well-structured components that are easy to understand, test, and scale.
whyMe.card2Desc: Optimized images, lazy loading, and clean code to ensure fast page loads on all devices.
whyMe.card3Desc: Every layout is designed and tested to look great on phones, tablets, laptops, and wide screens.
whyMe.card4Desc: Good grasp of computer science fundamentals, data structures, and practical logic.
